summary: Implementation plan for the dedicated Class 9 Result Tab in Vidyalayam. Covers complete exam configurations (First Exam, Second Exam, Periodic Tests 1 & 2, Internal Assessment 20M breakdown, Annual Exam 80M, Final Marksheet 200/2, and Annual Results in both 700M and 1000M formats), responsive spreadsheet grid with sticky student names, automatic GSEB Siddhi & Krupa calculations with manual override, comprehensive result register, and printable A4 marksheet cards.
